findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body: `canReadDocument` now returns `true` regardless of whether `userTenant` matches `documentTenant`. Any caller relying on this function for authorization can therefore permit cross-tenant document reads, bypassing the previous tenant boundary.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant equality enforcement
findings.body:
Every request now passes this authorization check, including `userTenant !== documentTenant`, enabling cross-tenant document access wherever this function gates reads.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the exported document label contract
findings.body:
Consumers comparing, persisting, or testing the exported canonical value `"Document"` now receive `"Document record"` instead. This breaks both its runtime value and inferred TypeScript literal type.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any caller passing unequal `userTenant` and `documentTenant` values receives `true`, allowing cross-tenant document access and bypassing the previous authorization boundary.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
